papers.title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.

papers.abstract_zh: 细粒度图文检索要求模型不仅能评估图像与文本之间的全局语义一致性，还要为局部文本语义（包括物体、属性、数量、动作和关系）建模视觉证据，从而区分语义相似的候选。现有方法通常使用固定的图像块、检测区域或文本词元作为基本匹配单元，然后通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累加来聚合局部交互。此类策略在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面仍存在局限。本文提出一种分层细粒度跨模态对齐框架，称为HFCMA。该框架逐步将低层图像块和词元表示转化为自适应视觉区域和文本短语，然后在全局检索评分过程中执行结构化的区域-短语匹配。具体而言，HFCMA首先采用动态粒度发现（DGD）将原始图像块和词元聚合为语义紧凑的视觉区域和文本短语。随后，它将区域-短语匹配建模为熵正则化最优输运问题，从而在全局边缘约束下估计结构化对齐矩阵。为减少背景噪声和局部语义漂移，HFCMA进一步引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权和原型一致性正则化。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO上的实验表明，HFCMA在双编码器检索框架下有效结合了动态语义单元构建与基于OT的结构化匹配。由此得到的细粒度得分可为候选排序提供结构化局部对齐信息，并提升对细微语义差异的判别能力。

papers.title: DriveWorld3D Evidence Constrained 3D World Modeling and Generative Simulation for Real-World Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Three dimensional modeling for autonomous driving must continuously estimate road geometry, obstacle occupancy, traffic participant behavior, and observational uncertainty under limited computational resources. Existing reconstruction methods can synthesize realistic novel views, but visual fidelity does not sufficiently characterize the geometric reliability required for driving. Generative world models can expand scenarios and predict future observations, yet may introduce content unsupported by measurements. We propose DriveWorld3D, a framework combining temporal video learning, measurement constraints from multiple sensors, and offline generative simulation. Its online component maintains a unified world state comprising road surfaces, volumetric occupancy, dynamic entities, and road relations, while separately representing physical occupancy, observability, and evidence provenance. Action conditioned future prediction and risk sensitive planning connect this representation to driving decisions. Its offline component reconstructs recorded scenes using neural radiance fields or 3D Gaussian Splatting, then expands long tail conditions using generative models while restricting the use of generated content as geometric ground truth. We specify data partitioning, sensor ablations, fault injection, paired closed loop testing, and real to simulation consistency assessment. The central hypothesis is that explicit evidence management can reduce dangerous false free space predictions and occlusion risk within a matched computational budget while retaining acceptable driving efficiency. All performance claims remain subject to experimental validation. Keywords: autonomous driving; 3D occupancy; sensor fusion; uncertainty; generative world models; NeRF; 3D Gaussian Splatting; closed loop simulation

papers.title: RadarXFormer: Robust Object Detection via Cross-Dimension Fusion of 4D Radar Spectra and Images for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Reliable perception is essential for autonomous driving systems to operate safely under diverse real-world traffic conditions. However, camera- and LiDAR-based perception systems suffer from performance degradation under adverse weather and lighting conditions, limiting their robustness and large-scale deployment in intelligent transportation systems. Radar-vision fusion provides a promising alternative by combining the environmental robustness and cost efficiency of millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar with the rich semantic information captured by cameras. Nevertheless, conventional 3D radar measurements lack height resolution and remain highly sparse, while emerging 4D mmWave radar introduces elevation information but also brings challenges such as signal noise and large data volume. To address these issues, this paper proposes RadarXFormer, a 3D object detection framework that enables efficient cross-modal fusion between 4D radar spectra and RGB images. Instead of relying on sparse radar point clouds, RadarXFormer directly leverages raw radar spectra and constructs an efficient 3D representation that reduces data volume while preserving complete 3D spatial information. The "X" highlights the proposed cross-dimension (3D-2D) fusion mechanism, in which multi-scale 3D spherical radar feature cubes are fused with complementary 2D image feature maps. Experiments on the K-Radar dataset demonstrate improved detection accuracy and robustness under challenging conditions while maintaining real-time inference capability.

papers.title: Learning from Failures: Retrieval-Centric CoT via Hard Negatives for Unified Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract: Unified multimodal retrieval aims to identify candidates that satisfy complex user intent expressed through heterogeneous inputs. Although Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM)-based retrievers are efficient and scalable, directly encoding raw multimodal inputs often misses fine-grained discriminative cues, leading to confusion among semantically similar candidates. Recent methods mitigate this limitation by generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales to enrich the query representation. However, such reasoning is typically derived from the query alone: it explains what the query describes, but not what the retriever misunderstands. We argue that effective retrieval reasoning should instead be conditioned on retrieval feedback. Based on this insight, we introduce UniME-R1, an embedder-adviser framework that learns to reason over initially retrieved candidates and generate Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT). The adviser analyzes candidates individually to identify the discriminative cues confused by the embedder. If the target appears in the initial top-k set, UniME-R1 directly reranks the candidates; otherwise, it generates RC-CoT to refine the retrieval direction and performs full-corpus re-retrieval with a dual-mode embedder. To train the framework, we mine hard negatives to simulate realistic retrieval failures, jointly optimize direct retrieval and RC-CoT-augmented retrieval, and align the adviser with retrieval outcomes through supervised learning and retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and a diverse set of general multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that UniME-R1 consistently improves retrieval performance over strong baselines.

papers.abstract_zh: 统一多模态检索旨在识别满足由异构输入表达的复杂用户意图的候选对象。尽管基于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的检索器高效且可扩展，但直接编码原始多模态输入往往遗漏细粒度判别线索，导致语义相似候选之间发生混淆。近期方法通过生成思维链（CoT）理由来丰富查询表示，以缓解这一局限。然而，此类推理通常仅从查询本身导出：它解释查询描述了什么，却不解释检索器误解了什么。我们认为，有效的检索推理应转而以检索反馈为条件。基于这一见解，我们提出UniME-R1，一种嵌入器-顾问框架，学习对初始检索到的候选进行推理并生成检索中心思维链（RC-CoT）。顾问逐个分析候选，以识别嵌入器所混淆的判别线索。若目标出现在初始top-k集合中，UniME-R1直接对候选重排；否则，它生成RC-CoT以细化检索方向，并使用双模式嵌入器执行全语料重检索。为训练该框架，我们挖掘难负例以模拟现实检索失败，联合优化直接检索与RC-CoT增强检索，并通过监督学习和面向检索的强化学习使顾问与检索结果对齐。在MMEB-V2及一组多样化的通用多模态检索基准上的大量实验表明，UniME-R1持续优于强基线并提升检索性能。

papers.title: No Hard Negatives Required: Concept Centric Learning Leads to Compositionality without Degrading Zero-shot Capabilities of Contrastive Models
papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language (V&L) models remain a popular choice for various applications. However, several limitations have emerged, most notably the limited ability of V&L models to learn compositional representations. Prior methods often addressed this limitation by generating custom training data to obtain hard negative samples. Hard negatives have been shown to improve performance on compositionality tasks, but are often specific to a single benchmark, do not generalize, and can cause substantial degradation of basic V&L capabilities such as zero-shot or retrieval performance, rendering them impractical. In this work we follow a different approach. We identify two root causes that limit compositionality performance of V&Ls: 1) Long training captions do not require a compositional representation; and 2) The final global pooling in the text and image encoders lead to a complete loss of the necessary information to learn binding in the first place. As a remedy, we propose two simple solutions: 1) We obtain short concept centric caption parts using standard NLP software and align those with the image; and 2) We introduce a parameter-free cross-modal attention-pooling to obtain concept centric visual embeddings from the image encoder. With these two changes and simple auxiliary contrastive losses, we obtain SOTA performance on standard compositionality benchmarks, while maintaining or improving strong zero-shot and retrieval capabilities. This is achieved without increasing inference cost. We release the code for this work at https://github.com/saic-fi/concept_centric_clip.

papers.abstract_zh: 对比视觉语言（V&L）模型仍然是各种应用中的热门选择。然而，一些局限性已经出现，最显著的是V&L模型学习组合表示的能力有限。先前的方法通常通过生成定制训练数据来获得困难负样本来解决这一局限。困难负样本已被证明能提升组合性任务的性能，但往往针对单一基准、无法泛化，并可能导致零样本或检索性能等基本V&L能力大幅下降，使其不切实际。在本工作中，我们采用不同的方法。我们识别出限制V&L组合性性能的两个根本原因：1）长训练字幕不要求组合表示；2）文本和图像编码器中的最终全局池化导致学习绑定所需信息完全丢失。作为补救，我们提出两个简单方案：1）我们使用标准NLP软件获得短的概念中心字幕片段，并将其与图像对齐；2）我们引入无参数的跨模态注意力池化，从图像编码器获得概念中心的视觉嵌入。通过这两项改变和简单的辅助对比损失，我们在标准组合性基准上获得SOTA性能，同时保持或提升强大的零样本和检索能力。这在不增加推理成本的情况下实现。我们在https://github.com/saic-fi/concept_centric_clip 发布了本工作的代码。

reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 细粒度图文检索要求模型不仅能评估图像与文本之间的全局语义一致性，还要为局部文本语义（包括物体、属性、数量、动作和关系）建模视觉证据，从而区分语义相似的候选。现有方法通常使用固定的图像块、检测区域或文本词元作为基本匹配单元，然后通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累加来聚合局部交互。此类策略在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面仍存在局限。本文提出一种分层细粒度跨模态对齐框架，称为HFCMA。该框架逐步将低层图像块和词元表示转化为自适应视觉区域和文本短语，然后在全局检索评分过程中执行结构化的区域-短语匹配。具体而言，HFCMA首先采用动态粒度发现（DGD）将原始图像块和词元聚合为语义紧凑的视觉区域和文本短语。随后，它将区域-短语匹配建模为熵正则化最优输运问题，从而在全局边缘约束下估计结构化对齐矩阵。为减少背景噪声和局部语义漂移，HFCMA进一步引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权和原型一致性正则化。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO上的实验表明，HFCMA在双编码器检索框架下有效结合了动态语义单元构建与基于OT的结构化匹配。由此得到的细粒度得分可为候选排序提供结构化局部对齐信息，并提升对细微语义差异的判别能力。

reserve_papers.title: DriveWorld3D Evidence Constrained 3D World Modeling and Generative Simulation for Real-World Autonomous Driving
reserve_papers.abstract: Three dimensional modeling for autonomous driving must continuously estimate road geometry, obstacle occupancy, traffic participant behavior, and observational uncertainty under limited computational resources. Existing reconstruction methods can synthesize realistic novel views, but visual fidelity does not sufficiently characterize the geometric reliability required for driving. Generative world models can expand scenarios and predict future observations, yet may introduce content unsupported by measurements. We propose DriveWorld3D, a framework combining temporal video learning, measurement constraints from multiple sensors, and offline generative simulation. Its online component maintains a unified world state comprising road surfaces, volumetric occupancy, dynamic entities, and road relations, while separately representing physical occupancy, observability, and evidence provenance. Action conditioned future prediction and risk sensitive planning connect this representation to driving decisions. Its offline component reconstructs recorded scenes using neural radiance fields or 3D Gaussian Splatting, then expands long tail conditions using generative models while restricting the use of generated content as geometric ground truth. We specify data partitioning, sensor ablations, fault injection, paired closed loop testing, and real to simulation consistency assessment. The central hypothesis is that explicit evidence management can reduce dangerous false free space predictions and occlusion risk within a matched computational budget while retaining acceptable driving efficiency. All performance claims remain subject to experimental validation. Keywords: autonomous driving; 3D occupancy; sensor fusion; uncertainty; generative world models; NeRF; 3D Gaussian Splatting; closed loop simulation

reserve_papers.title: RadarXFormer: Robust Object Detection via Cross-Dimension Fusion of 4D Radar Spectra and Images for Autonomous Driving
reserve_papers.abstract: Reliable perception is essential for autonomous driving systems to operate safely under diverse real-world traffic conditions. However, camera- and LiDAR-based perception systems suffer from performance degradation under adverse weather and lighting conditions, limiting their robustness and large-scale deployment in intelligent transportation systems. Radar-vision fusion provides a promising alternative by combining the environmental robustness and cost efficiency of millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar with the rich semantic information captured by cameras. Nevertheless, conventional 3D radar measurements lack height resolution and remain highly sparse, while emerging 4D mmWave radar introduces elevation information but also brings challenges such as signal noise and large data volume. To address these issues, this paper proposes RadarXFormer, a 3D object detection framework that enables efficient cross-modal fusion between 4D radar spectra and RGB images. Instead of relying on sparse radar point clouds, RadarXFormer directly leverages raw radar spectra and constructs an efficient 3D representation that reduces data volume while preserving complete 3D spatial information. The "X" highlights the proposed cross-dimension (3D-2D) fusion mechanism, in which multi-scale 3D spherical radar feature cubes are fused with complementary 2D image feature maps. Experiments on the K-Radar dataset demonstrate improved detection accuracy and robustness under challenging conditions while maintaining real-time inference capability.
first_author_affiliations: Global Institute of Future Technology , Shanghai Jiao Tong University , Shanghai , 200240 , China

reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 可靠感知对于自动驾驶系统在多样化真实交通条件下安全运行至关重要。然而，基于相机和LiDAR的感知系统在恶劣天气与光照条件下会出现性能退化，限制了其在智能交通系统中的鲁棒性和大规模部署。雷达–视觉融合提供了一种有前景的替代方案，它将毫米波（mmWave）雷达的环境鲁棒性和成本效率与相机捕获的丰富语义信息相结合。然而，传统3D雷达测量缺乏高度分辨率且高度稀疏，而新兴的4D毫米波雷达虽引入仰角信息，却也带来信号噪声和数据量大等挑战。为解决这些问题，本文提出RadarXFormer，一个实现4D雷达频谱与RGB图像之间高效跨模态融合的3D目标检测框架。RadarXFormer不依赖稀疏雷达点云，而是直接利用原始雷达频谱，并构建高效3D表示，在保留完整3D空间信息的同时减少数据量。“X”突出所提出的跨维度（3D-2D）融合机制，其中多尺度3D球面雷达特征立方体与互补的2D图像特征图相融合。在K-Radar数据集上的实验表明，在具有挑战性的条件下检测精度和鲁棒性得到提升，同时保持实时推理能力。

reserve_papers.title: Learning from Failures: Retrieval-Centric CoT via Hard Negatives for Unified Multimodal Retrieval
reserve_papers.abstract: Unified multimodal retrieval aims to identify candidates that satisfy complex user intent expressed through heterogeneous inputs. Although Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM)-based retrievers are efficient and scalable, directly encoding raw multimodal inputs often misses fine-grained discriminative cues, leading to confusion among semantically similar candidates. Recent methods mitigate this limitation by generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales to enrich the query representation. However, such reasoning is typically derived from the query alone: it explains what the query describes, but not what the retriever misunderstands. We argue that effective retrieval reasoning should instead be conditioned on retrieval feedback. Based on this insight, we introduce UniME-R1, an embedder-adviser framework that learns to reason over initially retrieved candidates and generate Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT). The adviser analyzes candidates individually to identify the discriminative cues confused by the embedder. If the target appears in the initial top-k set, UniME-R1 directly reranks the candidates; otherwise, it generates RC-CoT to refine the retrieval direction and performs full-corpus re-retrieval with a dual-mode embedder. To train the framework, we mine hard negatives to simulate realistic retrieval failures, jointly optimize direct retrieval and RC-CoT-augmented retrieval, and align the adviser with retrieval outcomes through supervised learning and retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and a diverse set of general multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that UniME-R1 consistently improves retrieval performance over strong baselines.

reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 统一多模态检索旨在识别满足由异构输入表达的复杂用户意图的候选对象。尽管基于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的检索器高效且可扩展，但直接编码原始多模态输入往往遗漏细粒度判别线索，导致语义相似候选之间发生混淆。近期方法通过生成思维链（CoT）理由来丰富查询表示，以缓解这一局限。然而，此类推理通常仅从查询本身导出：它解释查询描述了什么，却不解释检索器误解了什么。我们认为，有效的检索推理应转而以检索反馈为条件。基于这一见解，我们提出UniME-R1，一种嵌入器-顾问框架，学习对初始检索到的候选进行推理并生成检索中心思维链（RC-CoT）。顾问逐个分析候选，以识别嵌入器所混淆的判别线索。若目标出现在初始top-k集合中，UniME-R1直接对候选重排；否则，它生成RC-CoT以细化检索方向，并使用双模式嵌入器执行全语料重检索。为训练该框架，我们挖掘难负例以模拟现实检索失败，联合优化直接检索与RC-CoT增强检索，并通过监督学习和面向检索的强化学习使顾问与检索结果对齐。在MMEB-V2及一组多样化的通用多模态检索基准上的大量实验表明，UniME-R1持续优于强基线并提升检索性能。

reserve_papers.title: No Hard Negatives Required: Concept Centric Learning Leads to Compositionality without Degrading Zero-shot Capabilities of Contrastive Models
reserve_papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language (V&L) models remain a popular choice for various applications. However, several limitations have emerged, most notably the limited ability of V&L models to learn compositional representations. Prior methods often addressed this limitation by generating custom training data to obtain hard negative samples. Hard negatives have been shown to improve performance on compositionality tasks, but are often specific to a single benchmark, do not generalize, and can cause substantial degradation of basic V&L capabilities such as zero-shot or retrieval performance, rendering them impractical. In this work we follow a different approach. We identify two root causes that limit compositionality performance of V&Ls: 1) Long training captions do not require a compositional representation; and 2) The final global pooling in the text and image encoders lead to a complete loss of the necessary information to learn binding in the first place. As a remedy, we propose two simple solutions: 1) We obtain short concept centric caption parts using standard NLP software and align those with the image; and 2) We introduce a parameter-free cross-modal attention-pooling to obtain concept centric visual embeddings from the image encoder. With these two changes and simple auxiliary contrastive losses, we obtain SOTA performance on standard compositionality benchmarks, while maintaining or improving strong zero-shot and retrieval capabilities. This is achieved without increasing inference cost. We release the code for this work at https://github.com/saic-fi/concept_centric_clip.

reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 对比视觉语言（V&L）模型仍然是各种应用中的热门选择。然而，一些局限性已经出现，最显著的是V&L模型学习组合表示的能力有限。先前的方法通常通过生成定制训练数据来获得困难负样本来解决这一局限。困难负样本已被证明能提升组合性任务的性能，但往往针对单一基准、无法泛化，并可能导致零样本或检索性能等基本V&L能力大幅下降，使其不切实际。在本工作中，我们采用不同的方法。我们识别出限制V&L组合性性能的两个根本原因：1）长训练字幕不要求组合表示；2）文本和图像编码器中的最终全局池化导致学习绑定所需信息完全丢失。作为补救，我们提出两个简单方案：1）我们使用标准NLP软件获得短的概念中心字幕片段，并将其与图像对齐；2）我们引入无参数的跨模态注意力池化，从图像编码器获得概念中心的视觉嵌入。通过这两项改变和简单的辅助对比损失，我们在标准组合性基准上获得SOTA性能，同时保持或提升强大的零样本和检索能力。这在不增加推理成本的情况下实现。我们在https://github.com/saic-fi/concept_centric_clip 发布了本工作的代码。
